root.label: Texas restaurants charge for chips and salsa

events.label: Texas restaurants charge for chips and salsa

slots.name: Casa Rio chip price
slots.sentence: San Antonio’s Casa Rio, for example, currently lists chips and salsa for $2 on its menu.

slots.name: Casa Rio charge date
slots.sentence: Tripadvisor reviews indicate the restaurant was charging for chips and salsa by at least 2024, predating the latest concerns over tomato tariffs.

slots.name: Tres Arcos chip price
slots.sentence: Texas Monthly reported that Tres Arcos, an upscale Tex-Mex restaurant in San Antonio, charges $3.95 for chips and salsa unless the table spends at least $25 on other food, in which case they are complimentary.

slots.name: Austin restaurants chip prices
slots.sentence: Texas Monthly also reported that Tex-Mex diner Habanero Cafe in Austin charges $5.25 for a basket of chips and salsa, while De Nada Cantina charges $7.50, though customers can get free chip refills.
